gary_2026_11_24_localhost_nyc_tavern_com.title: localhost:nyc: Tavern Community FinTech Cohort
gary_2026_11_24_localhost_nyc_tavern_com.label: Startup / Business
gary_2026_11_24_localhost_nyc_tavern_com.summary: Gary's Guide: Apply now for Tavern's December Cohort for FinTech founders & investors. FinTech founders are rebuilding the infrastructure behind how the world moves, lends, saves, & invests money. It's one of the biggest opportunities in tech, & one of the hardest to execute. Regulation, bank partnerships, compliance, fraud, & the challenge of earning customer trust mean the path from idea to scale is rarely straightforward. Founders who win usually have the right people around them. Tavern is launching a FinTech cohort for founders & investors to learn from each other, share hard-won playbooks, & build the companies that will define the future of finance, from conception to exit or IPO. Learn about achieving rapid growth from top-tier FinTech founders & investors. What is Tavern? Tavern is a membership community of 100+ founders, investors, & ecosystem builders divided into niche cohorts based on common interests. Members include VC-backed founders, bootstrapped founders, post-exit founders, angel investors, & high-profile VCs. We provide a caring & ambitious community, premium events including weekly VC office hours, & a variety of coworking & social spaces. This cohort launches December 1. Applications will be considered on a rolling basis until cohort launch. Application & interview are required prior to admission. This cohort is a paid program. Membership is $129/month. It includes all benefits of the Tavern Community membership, in addition to cohort-specific programming.

gary_2026_12_01_pm_2_0_product_mgmt_in_a.summary: Gary's Guide: Product Management in the Age of AIIf AI can write the PRD, summarize customer feedback, research competitors, & build prototypes what is the Product Managers job now?Join Pioneering Minds AI for an interactive workshop on how product management is changing in the age of AI, & what makes a great PM today.Well bring together both experienced old-school PMs & a new generation of AI-native PMs to compare how the role has evolved, which skills still matter, & what students should focus on if they want to work in product.What Well DiscussWhat great PMs looked like before AIWhich traditional PM skills still matterWhich parts of the job AI is already changingHow PMs can use AI for research, prototyping, prioritization, & product discoveryWhether PMs need to become more technicalWhy judgment, taste, communication, & problem selection may matter more than everWhat companies may look for in the next generation of PMsWell also discuss a bigger question:When AI makes execution easier, does the PMs real value shift from managing the process to deciding what should be built in the first place?No previous PM or technical experience is required. The session is designed primarily for students, aspiring PMs, & early-career professionals interested in product, startups, & AI.Hackathon PreviewThis workshop takes place the day before the Pioneering Minds AI Hackathon & will also serve as a warm-up for participants.Well share an early look at the hackathon tracks:Critical Thinking & LearningAI for Product Management WorkflowsLegal Tech WorkflowsFintech & Insurtech WorkflowsWell also provide guidance on choosing a strong problem, designing an AI-native workflow, & what judges will be looking for.If youre joining the hackathon, this is your chance to get a head start.About Pioneering Minds AIAt pioneeringminds.ai, we grow AI-native pioneers who build, deploy, & govern AI responsibly while keeping humans in the front seat.

gary_2026_12_02_ai_build_lab_for_founder.title: AI Build Lab For Founders - Launch & Read The Signal
gary_2026_12_02_ai_build_lab_for_founder.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_12_02_ai_build_lab_for_founder.summary: Gary's Guide: AI Build Lab for Founders Series Take your idea from concept to launch in a series of interactive sessions. Leverage AI tools to build a live product, put it in front of users, & leave with honest feedback, concrete next steps, & the tools to keep going - no coding background required. Session 3: Launch Acquire users, analyze the data, & make the call. Compare your live user engagement against pre-set targets, locate your audience's online channels, & run live outreach during the session. Evaluate the evidence to decide whether to persevere, pivot, or pause, & map out your next test. Who it is for Current NYU students, Alumni, & Faculty Coders & non-coders are welcome. Anyone who wants to explore ideas, is curious about entrepreneurship, or has started building. Deliverables for Session 3: Launch Get to your first users, a plan to market, or a path to pivot An evidence scorecard for your product, or MVP A decision: continue, change, or stop A 14-day plan for the next test Full series highlights Hands-on from start to finish. Every session ends with something real in hand, not just notes. Real customers, not guesses. Founders talk to 5 to 10 potential users & put a working product in front of them. Two tracks. No-code founders build with tools like Lovable, Replit, v0, & Bolt. Founders who code use Claude Code or Cursor. Honest checks built in. Founders open & verify every source, set their success target before the results come in, & have a second tool test every build. A live product with a real ask. Each product goes live with a waitlist, pre-order, or booking option. Demo day. The series ends with founders presenting to guest founders & investors. Tools they keep. Every founder leaves with the full Leverage kit & their own working setup. What founders walk away with A tested idea. Assumptions checked against real conversations & real data. A live product MVP. Reviewed, tested, & in front of first users, or a clear & cheap "no." A decision & a plan. Continue, change, or stop, backed by evidence, with the next 14-day test written out. Their own working toolkit. Research, idea testing, building & review tools, set up & ready to use. The Leverage kit. Every prompt & tool used in the series. Entrepreneurship mindset. Check the sources. Set the target first. Never let the builder grade its own work. A cohort. A group of founders who built alongside them.

gary_2026_12_02_show_your_work_finance_l.title: Show Your Work: Finance Leaders On AI
gary_2026_12_02_show_your_work_finance_l.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_12_02_show_your_work_finance_l.summary: Gary's Guide: Happy Hour hosted by ADP x Campfire x Cloudzero x Corgi x JPM x Solvimon One last gathering before the year closes, & you won't want to miss it! Every board wants to see finance's AI plan. Some teams already close the books with agents, & others are just starting their first pilot. For one festive evening, we're bringing both together to swap notes & toast to what's next. Show Your Work An interactive panel of finance leaders at every stage of AI adoption, from we run it in production to we just started. Bring the question you can't ask in other rooms. Who's in Leaders from ADP, Campfire, Cloudzero, Corgi, JPM & Solvimon, plus CFOs, VPs of Finance, controllers & finance directors already putting AI to work. Format 5:30 PM: Arrivals 6:00 PM: Panel 6:30 PM: Drinks, bites, networking & demos 8:30 PM: End Apply to Attend Space is limited & every registration is approved. If you're a finance leader in New York, apply below & end the year with us. About the Hosts ADP is a global leader in payroll, HR & workforce management. Its platform covers payroll, tax compliance, benefits, time tracking & talent management for companies of every size, from startups hiring their first employees to global enterprises. Campfire is the AI-native ERP for high-growth companies. It automates categorization, reconciliation & revenue recognition, so customers close up to 5x faster. CloudZero is the cloud & AI cost intelligence platform. It turns messy cloud & AI bills into a clear view of unit economics, such as cost per customer or cost per feature, so finance & engineering teams can scale responsibly. Corgi is an AI-native insurance carrier for startups, offering fast, flexible coverage from D&O to cyber & AI liability. JPM is one of the world's largest financial services firms. Its Innovation Economy team works with startups, high-growth companies, founders & venture investors, offering banking, treasury & advisory support at every stage of growth. Solvimon is a billing & monetization platform from former Adyen leaders, built for usage-based & hybrid pricing across currencies & entities.

gary_2026_12_02_startup_founders_investo.summary: Gary's Guide: New York Startup Networking Event. Meet Founders, Investors, & Talent - Build or Scale Your Startup Bring a business question to the room Meet founders, entrepreneurs, builders, operators & investors at Ascent Valley's NYC mixer. Talk through business decisions & meet people you could work with. Locals & visitors are equally welcome. Bring a question about finding customers, building your team or growing your business. What to Expect Product & growth: discuss finding customers, product decisions & growing a business. Talent & hiring: meet builders & operators, talk about team needs & explore working together. Fundraising: share what you've learned about preparing a pitch & raising capital. Company pitches: discover what other companies are building & ask their representatives questions. Want to Pitch? gary_2026_12_03_cuny_it_conference_ai_di.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_12_03_cuny_it_conference_ai_di.place: John Jay College of Criminal Justice, 524 W 59th St
gary_2026_12_03_cuny_it_conference_ai_di.summary: Gary's Guide: The 2026 CUNY IT Conference focused theme is: AI Disruption & Opportunities. Artificial intelligence is reshaping higher education at extraordinary speed, altering how we teach, learn, conduct research, make decisions, design services, & imagine the future of our institutions. For many, AI represents disruption in its most immediate form-challenging long-standing assumptions about expertise, authorship, assessment, labor, privacy, & trust. Yet it also offers new opportunities to improve access, enhance student support, expand creativity, streamline operations, & open new possibilities for teaching & learning. AI is already changing the conditions under which higher education operates. The question is not whether institutions will respond, but how. This year's conference invites the CUNY community & its partners to share ideas, experiments, concerns, strategies, & discoveries that can help us navigate this moment with intelligence, imagination, & care. If you are exploring how AI is disrupting familiar practices-or creating meaningful new opportunities-we encourage you to join us for this year's CUNY IT Conference!

jc_culture_45561_2026_12_11_ugly_sweater.summary: Family Promise of Hudson County invites the community to celebrate the holiday season at its Ugly Sweater & PJ Dance Party, a festive fundraiser combining holiday entertainment with a meaningful cause. Guests are encouraged to wear their most outrageous holiday sweaters or coziest festive pajamas for an evening featuring music by DJ Smiley, dancing, an Ugly Sweater Showdown, exciting raffles, and food and beverages available for purchase. The event offers an opportunity for friends, neighbors, and community members to come together, make new connections, and enjoy a memorable evening while giving back. All proceeds from the event will support Family Promise of Hudson County’s efforts to provide families experiencing homelessness with the resources, guidance, and opportunities they need to create lasting change for themselves and their children.

jc_culture_10003581_2026_12_16_hamilton_.title: Hamilton Park Farmers Market 2026
jc_culture_10003581_2026_12_16_hamilton_.label: Festival / Market
jc_culture_10003581_2026_12_16_hamilton_.place: Hamilton Park, 9 McWilliams Pl., Jersey City, NJ
jc_culture_10003581_2026_12_16_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.
